programme.title: Blippi Wonders

He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders

Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Meekah is visiting O2B Kids in Orlando, Florida! First, she learns some cool new dance moves. After a special warm-up and practicing an eight-count, she learns hip hop, breakdancing and ballet! Then, Meekah is off to the science lab to make elephant toothpaste! She searches the play market and indoor playground to find all the ingredients needed for her special science experiment. It's a day of dancing and discovery!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for some awesome vehicle adventures with Meekah! First, she explores all the vehicles in Pretend City! With the help of her tools, she fixes cars, boats and trucks and even races to see how fast she can repair them all! Then, Meekah lines up to race her toy race car but notices the number has disappeared! She looks for her missing number in the mini golf course, the Formula 1 Fan Zone and the Pit Stop!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she gets creative with paint and cake! First, she visits the Paint Place in New York City, where she creates mixed media art inspired by the city skyline using materials like paint, foam and cotton balls. Then, Meekah puts on her baker's hat to decorate a friendship cake for Blippi! She learns about primary colors by mixing them to make secondary colors and cuts out different shapes to decorate her cake with.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing new challenges! Pogo is shunned by everyone after his latest prank backfires, so he ventures to prove that he's a changed Bod. Then, Slick enlists Bubbles as his dance partner for an upcoming competition but is horrified to realize that she's the worst dancer ever! How will he get out of this commitment? Finally, Slick recruits Newt to be his assistant for his latest ambition: to be a great magician!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods follows the wacky adventures of seven unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Suspended from the team, Shakes uses the time off to investigate his father's disappearance on Mt. Kilimanjaro. While evading a mad snowboarder and an avalanche, Shakes can't help but monitor his teammates' every move from afar.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: In a last-ditch effort to stay in the running for the final, Coach drops his team in the Amazon for some wild training. Shakes is amped, but El Matador isn't himself. Who is he?! And what does a mysterious photographer have to do with it?

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: All set to play Iron Tank for a place in the final, Supa Strikas can't resist a no-rules pick-up game aboard a massive tanker. But when an uninvited guest steers the ship towards disaster, will they rise above rivalry and work together?

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The big move to California is almost complete! First, Park Ranger Aaron creates a series of exciting challenges for the new park rangers. These tasks test their skills and teamwork, making sure everything is in place for a safe and fun environment for the dinosaurs. Then, Park Rangers Aaron and LB successfully transport the final dinosaur to the new Dinosaur Park. To celebrate their amazing accomplishment, everyone has a fun pool party with exciting games and mystery surprise toys!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: A T-Rex is on the loose and on the rampage at T-Rex Ranch! First, Park Rangers Tara and Asher must work together as a team to track down the rampaging dinosaur at Dino Base Camp and bring everything back under control. Then, it's Park Ranger Zoey's first day on the job, but things quickly turn chaotic when another giant T-Rex escapes! Zoey must act fast to manage the situation and prove herself as a capable park ranger.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The Park Rangers are trying out some awesome new dino gadgets! First, Park Rangers LB and Aaron must escape a giant T-Rex! Armed with their new science inventions-an invisible cloak and a hologram projector-they cleverly outsmart the T-Rex and make a daring getaway. Then, Park Ranger Darren shows off his new awesome gadget, the Dino Translator! Join the park rangers as they go on an adventure to test out their new tool!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big problems! First, the perfect snowy day inspires Pogo to pull some pranks, but they go too far and he and Newt come face-to-face with a hungry bear! Then, Jeff is throwing a party to impress some snooty friends, but his high expectations cause his waiter to quit, leaving him in a disaster. The trouble continues when Newt is asked to look after a mystery parcel and can't resist taking a peek inside!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new obsessions! Jeff is convinced that Pogo is responsible for the theft of a bale of straw from his garden, but no one believes him. Jeff begins an obsessive quest to clear his name and prove that Pogo is behind it all! Then, feeling emasculated, Jeff seeks Fuse's help to teach him to be stronger and more macho. But it's not long before his new macho-ness becomes a problem.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

programme.title: Blippi

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle are turning little problems into big adventures! From playing a quiet game to avoid waking a napping neighbor to playing hide and seek with friends, every little problem is a big adventure!

programme.desc: Dan is a photography student. His professor rewards him for his excellent work with an SLR camera. Excited, Dan immediately starts exploring the features. programme.title: Jeepers Creepers: Reborn
programme.desc: The Horror Hound festival holds its first ever event in Louisiana, attracting hundreds of geeks, freaks and die-hard horror fans from far and wide. Fanboy Chase forces his girlfriend Laine to come along for the ride. As the event begins, Laine starts to experience unexplained premonitions and disturbing visions. As the blood-soaked entertainment builds to a frenzy, Laine believes that something unearthly has been summoned and that she is at the center of it.

programme.title: Main-Main Hantu
programme.desc: A team of netball players spend the night in a dilapidated bungalow taken care of by an elderly couple. They are spooked by things that go bump in the night. Is it spirits, or something far more nefarious?

programme.title: The Story of the Death
programme.desc: Border patrol Police Lieutenant Aod, sends his subordinates to bust a drug trafficking operation. Due to serving on the force for many years, he was away from his parents for a long time. Therefore, he requested to be transferred back to Bangkok to care for his parents. Many years later, his parents die from disease. Aod continues to live alone at home and does not associate with anyone.

programme.title: Congkak
programme.desc: Kazman buys a chalet by the lake and brings his family there for a getaway. His wife Sufiah feels uneasy from the moment she steps into the chalet, as though somebody, or something, is watching her. That night, their daughter Lisa starts playing congkak with an imaginary friend that her parents cannot see. This only makes Sufiah more anxious and she hurls the game into the middle of the lake. The following night, she awakes in the middle of the night to sounds of someone playing the congkak. She gets up to investigate and is shocked to see an old woman playing the congkak by herself. Soon after, Lisa disappears. Pak Tua who lives nearby comes forward to help them look for Lisa.

programme.title: The Slit Mouthed Woman
programme.desc: 30 years ago, in an ominous suburban town, the spirit of a woman turned up to terrorize youngsters. During her tragic lifetime, the woman in question had been severely disfigured by her psychotic husband, who slashed her from mouth-to-cheek with a pair of scissors. After her untimely death, she prowled the streets of the town, clad in a surgical mask and a long, sweeping coat, and would accost her victims, removing her mask to reveal her deformities as she queried, 'Am I pretty?' Any victim who answered negatively met an immediate grisly death. Now, after a lengthy absence, the woman's ghost returns to wreak another onslaught of terror on the community.

programme.title: The Slit Mouthed Woman 2
programme.desc: 1978, Gifu prefecture, Japan. Three sisters grow up on a chicken farm in a small town. The oldest sister, Yukie, is engaged to be married, the middle sister, Sachiko works at a beauty salon and the youngest, Mayu, is on the track team in high school. Their happy carefree lives are changed forever when Yukie's ex-boyfriend Suzuki commits an atrocious crime with Mayu as the tragic victim. Half-crazed and bent on revenge against their family, Suzuki mistakes Mayu for Yukie and pours acid all over her face. Overwhelmed by physical and psychological trauma, Mayu sinks deeper into depression and isolation, unresponsive to her sisters' encouragement. Meanwhile, chilling news of a serial murderer, who preys on the alumni of Mayu's high school, send shockwaves through their small town.

programme.title: Susuk
programme.desc: Imran is a good son to his mother. He takes care of his mother even though his mother has been behaving strangely ever since she fell sick. This had Imran thinking that his mother is possibly practicing a black magic called Susuk. Imran asks for advice from a religious man in the mosque to help him remove the Susuk.

programme.title: Pemain Kaset
programme.desc: A production team is visiting an old abandoned village house to determine if it is suitable for them to shoot a film there. While cleaning the house to prepare for the shooting, they discover a room within which a radio is playing Quranic verses on loop. Mindlessly, they turn the radio off. Strange happenings start to occur.

programme.title: You Die

The downside to it is that it will result in its user's death after twenty-four hours.

After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world and beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi and FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon and discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Get ready for some creative farm adventures with Ella! First, Ella brings school to Lellobee City Farm by creating a classroom in the Boogie Barn and teaching all her animal friends. Then, she helps Mei make some delicious jam using fresh strawberries, grapes and blueberries from the farm! The creative day ends with a magical night of stargazing, where Mei points out constellations that look just like the animals on the farm.

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's a day of big surprises at Lellobee City Farm! The adventure begins when Ella and Bee find a mysterious egg and have no idea who it belongs to. They become 'The Egg Detectives' and question all the birds, only to find out it's a tortoise egg! The surprises continue with the arrival of a brand new tractor and a visit from two very special guests: tiger twins who love to play hide-and-seek!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Being little can be tough, but Baby John is growing up! First, he thinks he's ready to be big and make all his own decisions, but Mom and Dad help him understand that being little is pretty awesome, too! Then, Mom helps Baby John learn how to express all his different emotions and feelings, from grumpy to happy to proud. When Baby John loses his pacifier, the whole family joins in to help him on the big search!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns how to play soccer! With help from his family, he practices his skills and learns that sharing the ball with friends makes the game even more fun. Get ready to move your body and score the winning goal!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Come on and join JJ's fun learning club! The adventure starts with a field trip to the farm where JJ and his friends learn to count to ten using apples. The learning continues in the classroom as Ms. Appleberry sends the kids on a scavenger hunt to find items in every color of the rainbow. Even lunchtime is fun, as the family finds all the different shapes in JJ's lunch! From taking care of pets to learning yoga, there's always something new to learn!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Get your dancing shoes ready for JJ's Splashin' Jungle Jams! The party starts at the beach with a fun game of freeze dance on the sand. Then, dive deep under the sea to learn the ABCs with jellyfish and shark friends and swim like a beautiful mermaid! The adventure continues deep in the jungle where you can dance with gorillas, snakes and crocodiles. From popping bubbles to doing a silly animal dance, it's a wild party at the beach and in the jungle!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Join Morphle, Mila, and Jordie as they face off against the Magic Pets in a wild soccer match! With Incra and Telepup using their powers, Team Morphle will have to get creative to win the trophy. It's a magical, winner-take-all game!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Welcome to the wacky world of Winston and Orphle! First, Winston tricks a Magic Pet into growing his robots of Mila and Morphle big enough to steal the entire Magic Pet Center! Then, Orphle causes trouble on his own when he runs away with the cake Mila made for her and Morphle's Matchiversary. The two troublemakers team up to try and get their hands on a special surprise gift, but it's up to Mila and Morphle to stop them!

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are dealing with a messy guest, a cracked egg, a hoppy friend and a ruined teddy! Jeff meets a cute but very messy Floofer and has to learn to live with his new friend's untidy habits. Then, Lulu finds a colorful egg, and when it cracks, a cute chick hatches that she doesn't want to let go! The challenges continue as Newt tries to nurse an injured Oddfrog back to health and Pogo feels guilty after accidentally ruining Newt's teddy bear-shaped hedge.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Join Bubbles for a day of magic, a blob, a show and a bubble! First, Bubbles is excited to watch Pogo's magic show, but her curiosity gets the better of her and she spoils his tricks! Then, she invents a brand new bouncy blob, but it bounces out of control and causes havoc all over the Bodpod! The adventures continue as Bubbles gets stage fright before a big show and tries her best to stop a giant, beautiful bubble from popping.

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's always a busy day at Gecko's Garage! The fun starts when Fiona the Fire Truck arrives with a broken hose that needs a clever fix. Then, Baby Truck comes in after playing in muddy puddles and needs a trip through the car wash machine. The day gets even busier with a late-night emergency wheel change for Bobby, which Gecko must do without waking up the sleeping Mechanicals! Plus, the Mechs have to work as a team when Gecko is feeling unwell.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Join Gecko for the garage football championship! When Weasel starts cheating, Gecko must fix the damaged players and use smart strategy to win the game. Help Gecko show everyone that playing fair is the only way to be a true champion!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Get ready for a barnyard boogie with JJ and his friends! The dance party kicks off on the farm with a fun rendition of the 'Yes, Yes Vegetable Song,' where all the animals come to dance. Then, it's time to wake up the little bunny friends with a merry tune and hop, march and skip around! Join the fun as the kids sing 'Old Macdonald,' ride a little green tractor to find their animal pals and search for five little ducks all over the farm. It's a day full of singing, dancing and farm fun!

programme.title: Cody Time

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Get ready for a super creative day of play with Twinkle! First, it's time to get musical! Each toadstool makes a different musical note, allowing Twinkle and Sandy the Seagull to create a musical tune. Then, get creative as Twinkle has fun painting a picture of what she sees. The fun continues as Twinkle shares a box full of super fun toys, and her friends learn how to play new musical instruments!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Join Twinkle for some fun adventures and sleepy songs! First, help Twinkle find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make along the way! Listen as Mr. Moon sings a soothing lullaby to help Twinkle drift off to sleep for a peaceful night's rest.

programme.title: KiiYii

programme.title: KiiYii
